use_cases: Interactive hero section for landing pages showcasing brand identity
Dynamic background effect for company or product homepages
Creative logo reveal animation for presentations
Eye-catching visual element for splash pages
ai_summary: An interactive particle animation component that renders a logo with hundreds of particles which respond dynamically to mouse and touch input. Particles scatter and reassemble around the logo shape, creating a mesmerizing visual effect. The component includes mobile detection for responsive sizing and uses canvas for performant rendering.
